notes.title: Sitting Update
notes.content:
- Sitting enabled on most benches, chairs and toilets. 

To activate FP users simply point at a bench/chair and press LMB or Right Trigger. Press again to return to normal walking mode. 

VR users are no longer obstructed by the collision of benches/chairs so sitting can be simulated with IRL props.

notes.title: Bread Physics Update
notes.content:
Another year, another update. You can now pick up and throw bread.

I re-architected the VR pawn to support physics interactions. This means your virtual hands collide with objects and you can interact with physics objects, like bread and doors, in a more realistic manner. This kind of interaction system is much more complicated to implement so expect glitches and bugs. Also, I haven't been able to test it adequately on Oculus gear. Please provide feedback on your experience in the discussions or Discord.

- The VR pawn was re-architected to support physics-based interactions. No more ghost hands clipping into objects.
- VR users can now pick up or throw bread using the trigger.
- FP users have basic pick up and drop abilities using the left mouse button.
- VR users can interact with doors by grabbing the handle or pushing or pulling them with their hands.
- Random small bug fixes.

notes.title: Basic Gamepad Support, Abyss Door Locked
notes.content:
- Basic gamepad support added. *Tested on XBOX controller only.
- A door that wasn’t supposed to be unlocked has been locked again...for now.
- A few tweaks to transitions and level streaming. 
- Falling through the floor should take you back to the foyer.

notes.title: Transition Update
notes.content:
I've been working on a number of random fixes and tweaks over the past few weeks. Hopefully everything runs a little smoother now. You may not notice much because a lot of the changes are under-the-hood.

Please let me know if you find any glitches and i will try to fix them asap. Also I really appreciate all the feedback about the controls (good and bad). I'm very interested in continually tweaking and improving them.

Here are some of the highlights...

- Player acceleration enhanced.
- VR snap turn now correctly rotates around the player’s location.
- Added jump and landing sounds.
- Transitions re-architected.
- Multiplayer level loading improved.
- Various performance and stability enhancements.
- VR players can now walk onto the bed.
- An existing door becomes unlocked when you satisfy all of the conditions.

notes.title: Multiplayer Steam Sessions Update
notes.content:
Multiplayer is now handled using Steam Sessions!

- This is a very basic implementation and will be improved over time.
- You can browse and join any available server hosting a game session.
- If you host a session it will be accessible to anyone on Steam playing EB-APT.
- Currently there are no tools to manage users who have joined your server.
- Please report any bugs or thoughts for improvements, necessities. You can do so on the Discord or in the community chat.

notes.title: A Soft Opening
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, we will have a small gathering in the space on Sept, 18th at 10AM EDT. 

- Enter the Game
- Go to the lobby elevator
- Select “MULTIPLAYER”
- Enter your NAME.
- Leave the “IP ADDRESS” text entry box blank
- Click “JOIN”
- You are In!

This is a small gathering and audio is not available in the game. You can watch and interact on twitch to follow the live streaming of the event. Search Chameleon Gallery on Twitch and you will find us.
We will have an artist talk and a conversation between the curator and the artist in the soft opening. You can use the twitch to listen to the conversation and interact with us with chat box. 
Hope to see you there.
